question: The Mundra Thermal Power Plant is located in which district of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kutch**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mundra Thermal Power Plant** is located in the **Kutch district** of Gujarat.
 
• It is one of the largest thermal power plants in India.
 
• The plant is operated by **Adani Power**, a subsidiary of the Adani Group.
 
• Mundra Thermal Power Plant has a total installed capacity of 4,620 MW.
 
• It plays a significant role in supplying power to the western region of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Adani Group** has invested heavily in the development of the Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone (SEZ) to facilitate trade and commerce.
 
• Mundra Port is the largest private port in India and is strategically important for both industrial and agricultural sectors.
 
• The power plant uses imported coal to generate electricity, ensuring a steady supply of power to the region.
 
• The plant incorporates advanced technologies to minimize environmental impact, including flue gas desulfurization and electrostatic precipitators.
 
• The **Mundra Thermal Power Plant** has been instrumental in boosting the economic development of the Kutch region.
